title: Domain Contract v2
description: Adds concepts[] as a first-class model element alongside the v1 contexts/terms/aggregates/relations shape (Issue #290, sdd-domain-concept-contract Phase 0). This file is additive: it duplicates the v1 boundedContext/term/aggregate/contextRelation definitions in-file rather than referencing domain-contract.v1.schema.json, so v1 stays byte-identical and unconsumed by this file (design.md DD-3). Referential integrity that JSON Schema draft-07 cannot express (concept.context membership, distinguished_from/term dangling references, duplicate ids, cross-field self-contradiction) is checked by validate-domain-contract.sh/.ps1, not this schema (design.md DD-1, INV-003).

version.description: Monotonic model version, bumped on every regeneration

generated_from.description: Repo-relative paths of the Markdown sources this contract was projected from

concepts.description: First-class domain concepts (requirements.md REQ-002). A project with no concepts stays on v1 -- v2 adoption itself is the opt-in.

canonical.description: Canonical English term as used in specs

forbidden_synonyms.description: Terms that must not be used in specs for this concept

concept_id.description: The concept this term names (v2 addition, requirements.md REQ-003). Optional. A concept_id that resolves to no declared concept is a validator error (V2-DANGLING-TERM), not a schema violation.

concept.description: A first-class domain concept: a name, a single bounded-context home, its responsibilities and non-responsibilities, and the evidence/perspectives that justify its boundary (requirements.md REQ-002, design.md DD-1). Single-context membership is declared here as a required scalar field; enforcing that the value names a declared context is the validator's job (design.md DD-1, INV-003), because draft-07 cannot express that cross-object reference.

id.description: Stable concept identifier. Referenced by distinguished_from[].concept_id and term.concept_id.

name.description: Canonical name given to the concept (PascalCase). The name is not the concept itself -- the same name may legitimately appear in two different contexts (requirements.md Edge Cases).

context.description: The single bounded context this concept belongs to (design.md DD-1). Must name a context declared in contexts[]; that referential integrity is checked by the validator, not this schema (INV-003).

definition.description: What in reality this concept carves out.

essence.description: A one-line statement of the concept's essence.

must_not_own.description: Responsibilities this concept must never own (explicit boundary contract). Optional -- absence is valid; a concept may list only what it owns at first and add must_not_own entries as boundary incidents occur.

stakeholder_perspectives.description: How different stakeholders see this concept (boundary discovery evidence). Optional.

distinguished_from.description: Records why this concept is distinct from another concept. Optional. Self-reference and dangling concept_id references are validator errors, not schema violations.

evidence.description: References to domain-story/event/issue material that grounds this concept.

concept_id.description: The other concept this entry distinguishes the owning concept from. A value equal to the owning concept's own id (self-reference) is invalid; that check is the validator's job, not this schema's.
